LanguageData.CC_PEv10_TalkerGone: The colony's best talker is not at home to hear them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_PeoplesGone: One of the two peoples is no longer at peace with the colony.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_RegionHears: The region hears of it, and the side passed over remembers
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_MootLetterLabel: The ruling on the old wood
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_MootShaft: The ruling is for the shaft: {UNION} may sink it under the old wood. {UNION} think better of the colony for it, and {MOSSBORN} think worse. For the next season, steel will be {PCT} in a hundred cheaper with every trader the colony deals with.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_MootWood: The ruling is that the old wood stays as it is. {MOSSBORN} think better of the colony for it, and {UNION} think worse. For the next season, herbal medicine, which {MOSSBORN} gather in that wood, will be {PCT} in a hundred cheaper with every trader the colony deals with.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_MootBargain: Both sides accepted the colony's terms: {UNION} will sink the shaft at the edge of the old wood and plant a seedling for every tree they fell there, which {MOSSBORN} will count. Both think a little better of the colony, and for the next season steel will be {PCT} in a hundred cheaper with every trader the colony deals with.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_MootNoBargain: {TALKER} looked for terms both could accept, but neither side would give way. {UNION} and {MOSSBORN} will settle it themselves, and both think a little less of the colony for it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_MootHeard: {TALKER} heard both envoys {WHERE} and gave the colony's ruling.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_MootByWord: The envoys could not wait to be heard, so the colony sent its ruling after them by word.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_HeardShaft: Word on the roads: the colony ruled for {UNION}'s shaft under the old wood, and {MOSSBORN} took it badly.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_HeardWood: Word on the roads: the colony ruled that the old wood stays, and {UNION} took it badly.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_HeardBargain: Word on the roads: the colony found terms over the old wood that {UNION} and {MOSSBORN} could both accept.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_HeardNoBargain: Word on the roads: {UNION} and {MOSSBORN} took their quarrel over the old wood to the colony, and it couldn't settle it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_PriceOver: A season has passed since the ruling on the old wood, and {THING} costs what it did before.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_Hearing: {0} hears both envoys at the colony's table for two hours, and then gives the ruling
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_HearingGate: {0} hears both envoys at the gate for two hours, and then gives the ruling
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_Steel: Steel comes {0} in a hundred cheaper from every trader for a season
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_Herbs: Herbal medicine comes {0} in a hundred cheaper from every trader for a season
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_Bargain: {0} has about {1} chances in a hundred to find terms: then both peoples +{2}, and steel {4} in a hundred cheaper for a season; otherwise both -{3}
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_TollCross: The carts of {WHEEL} are crossing the colony's land to the far edge, and the factor of {LEAGUE} has gone home to report it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_TollBack: The carts of {WHEEL} are going back to the road the way they came, and the factor of {LEAGUE} has thanked the colony.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_TollFair: {TALKER} sat with the factor of {LEAGUE} and the wheelwright of {WHEEL} at the gate and set a fair toll of {COUNT} silver, which the wheelwright paid on the spot. The carts are going on by the road.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_TollFairAlone: The factor of {LEAGUE} and the wheelwright of {WHEEL} waited for the colony at the gate, then settled on a toll of {COUNT} silver between themselves. The carts are going on by the road.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_HeardCross: Word on the roads: the colony let {WHEEL}'s carts across its land past {LEAGUE}'s toll, and the league took it badly.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_HeardBack: Word on the roads: the colony turned {WHEEL}'s carts back to {LEAGUE}'s toll, and the Wheel took it badly.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_HeardFair: Word on the roads: the colony set a fair toll between {LEAGUE} and {WHEEL} at its gate, and both accepted it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_CartsGone: The Wheel's carts are no longer at the edge of the colony's land.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_Cross: The carts of {0} walk across the colony's land and off at the far edge
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_Back: The carts of {0} go back out the way they came
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_Fair: {0} sits with both at the gate for two hours and sets a toll of about {1} silver, which the wheelwright pays the factor
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_PlagueCantGo: The colony can't spare them now: they are busy, away, or too few would be left at home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_PlagueThereDoctor: {PAWN_nameDef} has reached {PLACE} and is working in the sickhouse of {FACTION}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_PlagueThereDigger: {PAWN_nameDef} has reached {PLACE} and is digging graves with {FACTION}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_PlagueHomeDoctor: {PAWN_nameDef} is home from the sickhouse at {PLACE}. {FACTION} are grateful for the help.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_PlagueHomeDigger: {PAWN_nameDef} is home from digging graves at {PLACE}. {FACTION} are grateful for the help.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_PlagueHomeEarly: {PAWN_nameDef} is home from {PLACE} before the work there was done.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_PlagueDeedText: sent {PAWN_nameDef} to help at {PLACE} through the plague
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_Plague: {0} set out for {1}, each on their own, and stay {2} days before coming home
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_PlagueDoctor: {0} works on the order's ward each day and learns a good deal of healing
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_PlagueDiggers: {0} dig graves with the Bell each day and learn something of building
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_PlagueRisk: {0} may bring the sickness home: the same chance as anyone who lodges at a sick town
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_PlagueDeed: {0} and {1} will both remember it for a long time
LanguageData.CC_Memory_Deed_plagueYear_Name: stood by {NAME} in its plague year
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Copied: {COPYIST_nameDef} has copied the records of {VAULT} for another morning ({COUNT} of {OF}).
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Taught: {CRAFTER_nameDef} has spent the afternoon teaching the copyist of {SOCIETY} and the technician of {VAULT} at the bench.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_LearnDone: The copyist of {SOCIETY} and the technician of {VAULT} have gone home. The society has its copy of the vault's records and left a {BOOK} of it at the colony's table, and the vault has learned a craft from {CRAFTER} in {COUNT} afternoons. Both peoples will remember what they learned here.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_CopyDone: The copyist of {SOCIETY} and the technician of {VAULT} have gone home. The society has its copy of the vault's records and left a {BOOK} of it at the colony's table.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_CopyPart: The copyist of {SOCIETY} and the technician of {VAULT} have gone home with part of a copy of the vault's records. There was not time to finish it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_LearnNone: The copyist of {SOCIETY} and the technician of {VAULT} have gone home without copying anything at the colony's table.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_CrafterGone: The colony's crafter, or their bench, is gone.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_Host: They stay {1} days, each morning copying at the colony's table, eating the colony's meals and sleeping in its beds or on the floor
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_Book: With the copy finished, the society leaves the colony a {0} of it
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_Lessons: Each afternoon {0} teaches them both for two hours at the colony's bench
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_TeachSocial: {0} gets better at explaining things, and a little at crafting
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_Ages: {0} and {1} both learn here, which helps each of them along toward their next age
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_ArtTome: {TEACHER} spent the afternoon with {PAWN_nameDef} at the gate and then handed {PAWN_objective} {TOME}, the art of {FACTION}. {PAWN_nameDef} has started to read it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_ArtTomeLater: {TEACHER} spent the afternoon with {PAWN_nameDef} at the gate and then handed {PAWN_objective} {TOME}, the art of {FACTION}. It is lying beside {PAWN_objective}, for {PAWN_objective} to read when {PAWN_pronoun} can.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_ArtPassion: {TEACHER} spent the afternoon at the gate showing {PAWN_nameDef} how {FACTION} go about {SKILL}. {PAWN_nameDef} has taken an interest in it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_ArtBurning: {TEACHER} spent the afternoon at the gate showing {PAWN_nameDef} how {FACTION} go about {SKILL}. {PAWN_nameDef} was already interested in it, and now {PAWN_pronoun} cares about it more than anything else.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_ArtLesson: {TEACHER} spent the afternoon at the gate teaching {PAWN_nameDef} what {FACTION} know of {SKILL}, and {PAWN_nameDef} learned a great deal.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_ArtChronicle: {FACTION} handed their own art on to {PAWN_nameDef}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_ArtColonistGone: The colonist they came for is not at home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_ArtLeft: {TEACHER} of {FACTION} could not wait any longer and has gone home. {FACTION} may offer their art again another time.
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_Art: {0} spends the afternoon with {1} at the gate, showing {1} their art
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_ArtTome: {0} is handed {1} and reads it, by A RimWorld of Magic's own rules
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_ArtPassion: {0} finds a passion for {1}, or a deeper one
LanguageData.CC_PEv10_Impact_ArtOwed: The colony owes {0} for the lesson
